zh.summary: 用 AI 辅助起草、由专家审查的医疗器械监管文档服务。
zh.judgment: 交付“经过审查的文件”有清晰买方，但专家工时决定它是可扩展产品还是重人工服务。
zh.replaces: 器械团队分散整理技术资料，再由人员逐项起草和核对监管文件。
zh.product: 官网介绍 Clark 辅助文件起草与专家审查，覆盖监管路径、技术文件和生命周期工作。能力边界是支持文件准备，不是替客户保证审批结果；这一点决定产品怎样定义交付责任。
zh.customer: 潜在用户是医疗器械公司的监管与质量团队，付费者可能是企业本身，此为商业推断。价值在减少准备与返工的不确定性，尤其适合缺乏足够文档产能的团队，但要先确认材料缺口是劳动问题还是基础证据不足。
zh.workflow: 官网描述客户提供器械资料，AI 协助组织文件，专家在提交前审查。进一步尽调应抽查证据关联、版本管理和审查退回过程；生成速度不能抵消遗漏关键输入造成的返工。
zh.business_model: 官网强调固定成本与明确时间，但本次没有确认具体价目、收入或毛利。商业推断是按服务包或项目承接交付；每份文件的专家审查工时、返工比例和客户资料完整度，将决定实际利润。
zh.traction: 本次公开资料支持定位与流程描述，没有确认付费客户数、提交成功率或复购。即使文件经过专家审查，也不能从中推出审批结果；需要看可比项目的准备时长、退回原因和客户续购。
zh.moat: 通用起草工具和既有专业服务构成替代。潜在壁垒是审查知识、证据结构与可重复交付流程；若优势只来自专家本人而未沉淀为系统，增加项目会同比增加人力需求。
zh.funding_read: 种子前轮是早期服务经济验证的资金信号，金额不代表产品已有成熟市场。下一里程碑可看限定器械类型中的可重复交付、审查工时下降和客户复购；估值与具体资金用途未确认。
zh.risks: 客户原始资料不完整会增加返工；复杂器械的差异可能导致固定价格失去利润。若客户把辅助起草误读为结果保证，也会扩大交付预期与实际边界之间的落差。
zh.takeaway: 可借鉴“AI 先做、专家审查”的服务包装，但要把人工作业量做成可测指标。先限定一类交付任务与验收范围，证明重复项目的总工时下降，才能讨论扩大业务。
zh.watch_next: 看每项目专家工时、退回返工率、交付毛利和客户复购；按器械类型分组比较。若增长同时伴随等比例专家扩招，就应按服务经济而不是软件经济评估。

en.summary: An AI-assisted, expert-reviewed documentation service for medical-device companies.
en.judgment: Reviewed deliverables offer a clear buying unit, but expert labour determines scalability.
en.replaces: Fragmented preparation, manual drafting and repeated document review.
en.product: The site describes Clark-assisted drafting with expert review across documentation tasks. Supporting preparation should remain distinct from guaranteeing an approval result; this defines delivery responsibility.
en.customer: Regulatory and quality teams are plausible users, with their companies as buyers. This is an inference. The issue may be documentation capacity or missing underlying evidence, and these require different remedies.
en.workflow: The described sequence takes customer material through assisted preparation and expert review. Evaluation should inspect evidence links, versions and returned work. Generation speed cannot compensate for missing inputs.
en.business_model: The site advertises fixed cost and defined timelines; exact prices and margins were not established. Project or service packages are a hypothesis. Expert hours, rework and input quality would determine profitability.
en.traction: Paid customers, comparable outcomes and repeat purchases were not confirmed. Expert review does not establish an approval result. Preparation time and reasons for returned work would be useful evidence.
en.moat: Generic drafting tools and professional services are substitutes. Structured review knowledge and repeatable delivery could help defend the business; expertise remaining solely with individuals would scale labour with projects.
en.funding_read: Pre-seed funding supports early delivery validation without proving a mature market. Repeatable work within a limited device category and repeat buying would be useful milestones. Valuation and allocation were not confirmed.
en.risks: Incomplete inputs can increase rework. Device complexity may undermine fixed-price margins. Customers could also mistake preparation support for an outcome guarantee, widening the expectation gap.
en.takeaway: Package AI work with expert review while measuring human labour. Limit task scope and acceptance criteria first, then demonstrate falling total hours on repeat projects before broadening delivery.
en.watch_next: Watch expert hours, rework, delivery margin and repeat purchases by device category. If revenue needs proportional expert hiring, evaluate service rather than software economics.

The objective is not simply to generate documents, but to deliver reviewed outputs with a clear regulatory rationale. AI accelerates the work. Experts review the outcome. When can I use Ardeevo? At any stage of your regulatory path. From regulatory strategy assessments to the drafting of Technical Files and post-market monitoring. Do I need to replace my consultant or regulatory team? No. Ardeevo is designed to work alongside founders, regulatory teams, quality teams and external consultants. The goal is to reduce manual effort, give the documentation consistency and deliver on defined timelines, while preserving the expertise and decision-making responsibilities already present in your organisation. Does Ardeevo guarantee certification or CE marking? No. Ardeevo is not a Notified Body and does not guarantee certification or market access.
